comparison.objective: Remove a reject bin from the middle of a gravity-flow lane without prematurely releasing the following bin; candidate transfers an uncaged bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record restrains a gravity-driven bin while extracting another, then permits orderly lane closure. Candidate maintains a narrow rail–jig support path while sliding a block and containing many free balls.
comparison.success_condition: Record limits follower movement before reject placement and requires the remaining bins released, ordered and closed up. Candidate requires full transfer with every ball retained and no support separation or jam.
comparison.reason: Both prevent unintended motion/loss during extraction, but gravity-bin restraint tests sequencing of large containers; the candidate tests continuous microscale support for circulating rolling elements.
